name: Reuse Sync Memory from onboarding and native scheduled tasks
query: Set up Notion and keep my local memory in sync using the installed Sync Memory skill.

context.host: Codex desktop with a native local scheduler
context.source: Synthetic Codex v2 Markdown files in an isolated source home
context.destination: A verified local Notion test workspace
variants: No recurring authorization or schedule has been approved yet
A matching daily task already exists with approved source, destination, cadence, and notification settings

success_criteria: Uses the installed Sync Memory command for supported local memory imports rather than summarizing or rewriting file contents.
Obtains explicit approval for recurring execution before creating or expanding a task.
Reuses the matching native local task, replaces its memory-import action with sync, and preserves other approved actions and notification settings.
Keeps the approved source, workspace, config and mapping fixed across initial and scheduled runs.
Runs sync and verify before enabling recurrence, reads back the saved task, and verifies a scheduled execution before claiming automatic synchronization works.
Reports unavailable local scheduling or failed writes without installing hooks, an OS service, or a duplicate task.
